Where Light Meets Design

DESAMCO manufactures decorative and urban lighting poles, high masts and steel structures — engineered for safety, efficiency and innovative design.

Request a Quote

Our Vision & Mission

Our vision is to become a leading company locally and internationally in providing and manufacturing lighting poles, masts, steel structures and their valuable services.

Our mission is to provide integrated and effective products equipped with exceptional expertise and service to our customers and community with safety, efficiency, high quality and innovative thinking.

Our services are intentionally positioned to add value that boosts your organization's ability to innovate your products and maximize operational efficiency — so you can compete at the top of your market.

Decorative & Urban Lighting Poles

Classic Garden Lighting Collection

* Over 40 decorative arm and bracket configurations (C-series) and 36 street-luminaire arm styles (SAP series) are available to customize any classic pole.
